guide.heading: Getting started
guide.stepTheme: Enable the block in your theme

theme.heading: Enable Buy Together in your theme
theme.body: The widget doesn't appear on its own: add the block to the product page from the theme editor. Choose where it goes — this opens the editor with the block already inserted; then just position it and <bold>Save</bold>.

cart.heading: Cart cross-sell
cart.body: Show matching products right on the cart page. The block gathers companions for every item in the cart, drops what's already added and suggests the rest — each with its own add button.

metrics.emptyBody: Link a main product to products that go well together. Then add the “Buy Together” block on the product page from the theme editor.
